ABSOLUTE: no visible physical frame, mount, mat, wall or gallery environment in any preview, mosaic or final digital image; full-resolution edge check required

frame_policy.rule: NO_VISIBLE_FRAMES_OR_MOUNTS: image sources and images shown in any editorial review, gallery, mosaic, module hero, crop, thumbnail, archive/published output must contain artwork ONLY, with no visible physical frame, mount, mat, wall, label, pedestal or gallery environment.
frame_policy.acceptance: FAIL_CLOSED: if full-resolution original pixels have not been inspected for a frame, frame_status is UNVERIFIED and the image cannot pass QA, be promoted or presented as a vetted candidate. Images positively showing a frame are disallowed as previews and delivery assets.
frame_policy.candidate_distinction: Reject the framed photographic SOURCE only; do not silently reject the depicted historic artwork or erase earlier editorial approval.
frame_policy.clean_source_priority: Use pristine museum-origin artwork-only image. A separate clean source must replace framed photographs. Never simply conceal a frame by styling the webpage or treating a thumbnail as proof.
frame_policy.crop_rule: Crop only if a documented lossless/non-destructive trim can remove all extraneous borders without cutting painted canvas, signature, painted edge or relevant composition; inspect resulting full-resolution file. Prefer original artwork-only source.
frame_policy.release_gate: Require frame_status VERIFIED_NO_FRAME, visual QC, file-rights review, checksum, source accession, editorial approval and manual release permission. For now no candidate is publication-ready.
